## tested version
v4.7.beta5.mono.official [bbd3f43b5], v4.6.3.stable.mono.official [7d41c59c4]

## system iformation:
Godot v4.7.beta5.mono - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Tue, 02 Jun 2026 18:26:58 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Vega 8 Graphics (RADV RAVEN) - AMD Ryzen 5 2500U with Radeon Vega Mobile Gfx (8 threads) - 11.22 Gio memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

UP, Can confirm this bug, with my own project.

With this bug it becomes very hard to use modular environments where every module has a static body collision. And it's not only the problem for the modular environments but also for procedural generation because physics bodies don't get removed from the memory after calling `free` on nodes before re-generating an environment. Even if you make an auto collision combiner to make less static bodies in a scene, the memory will still leak with time. For some reason in cmd it shows half the leaked instances which you can see in the debugger's monitors tab. It's either the orphan nodes monitor doubles the amount or the engine underreports the amounts in its logs. In this screenshot you can see the memory grow after multiple (10) level generations (the level (run once) contains 90 P11JoltShape3D and 494 P10JoltBody3D according to the verbose mode debug log). ``` ERROR: 90 RID allocations of type 'P11JoltShape3D' were leaked at exit.
